_about: Evidence-status rules for hadith citations (plan item 13). The tool applies these rules mechanically; it never weighs one scholar against another. The Sharia reviewer writes, signs and dates this file. Until she signs, the rules below are the team's draft and the interface says so.

supported.when: Found in the two Sahihs, or every grading of the matching text by the approved scholars that Dorar returned is in an accepted category.

not_supported.en: Not supported by the approved sources
not_supported.when: Every grading of the matching text by the approved scholars is weak, very weak or fabricated. Red only when one of them is fabricated or baseless.

verify.when: The gradings differ, the wording differs, the written attribution is wrong, a grading speaks only about the chain, or the match was made by the model.

refer.when: Nothing was found, the source could not be reached, or the question asks for a fatwa.
